description: the ordinary people are terrified: they tremble, shrink into their seats and glance around nervously; the uncanny beings are delighted and curious: they lean forward, grin and tilt their heads, enjoying the show; then everyone settles back into the starting pose. The chairs, stairs, walls and background stay still: no camera movement, no zoom, no pan, no flicker.
subject_description: a seated TV studio audience in rows of red chairs, ordinary adults and uncanny beings, facing the camera
initial_pose: sitting still in their chairs, facing the camera
